feedback_text: Users frequently submit packages without required supporting documents
It is difficult to know which documents are missing
Vendor information is sometimes incomplete at intake
Users have difficulty locating the status of submissions
Older submissions are difficult to identify
Managers need visibility into delayed reviews
Financial discrepancies are sometimes discovered late
Repeated questions are received about required documentation
Vendor records occasionally contain incomplete information
Stakeholders want a simpler summary of procurement activity
Teams want to see pending submissions by stage
Duplicate submissions can create unnecessary review work
